props.gloss_en: bitter almonds, small -- obligated [in teruma and tithes]
R' Yosei (version 1): both this and that to exemption -- so the small [bitter] ones too are exempt
R' Yosei (version 2, ואמרי לה): both this and that to obligation -- so the large [bitter] ones too are obligated
R' Chanina ruled in Tzippori like the words of the one who says 'both this and that to exemption'
R' Yochanan: since one can sweeten them by means of fire
